en: A monochrome postcard depicting a quiet street in a small town or village. The image shows people standing along a dusty or unpaved road lined with old, stone and stucco buildings. Bare trees are visible in the background, suggesting either late autumn or winter. The text 'Saluti da Brentonico - Contrada Vigo' appears at the top, indicating a greeting from Brentonico, specifically from Contrada Vigo.
